advisories.title: GHSA-p5mv-gjc5-mwqv: use of an uninitialized variable in the GGUF loader
advisories.explanation: This llama.cpp build is exposed to a vulnerable GGUF loader path when it loads GGUF artifacts. Applicability records loader exposure; it does not claim that every GGUF file exploits the vulnerability.
advisories.action: Do not load the artifact with this runtime; update llama.cpp to build b2740 or later.

advisories.title: GHSA-56xg-wfcc-g829: template injection in llama-cpp-python
advisories.explanation: llama-cpp-python versions 0.2.30 through 0.2.71 render chat templates without sufficient sandboxing, allowing potential code execution through malicious template content.
advisories.action: Update llama-cpp-python to version 0.2.72 or later. If using llama.cpp directly (not the Python binding), this advisory does not apply.

advisories.title: GHSA-3p4r-fq3f-q74v: heap buffer overflow in GGUF mem_size calculation
advisories.explanation: This llama.cpp build is exposed to a vulnerable GGUF loader path when it loads GGUF artifacts. Applicability records loader exposure; it does not claim that every GGUF file exploits the vulnerability.
advisories.action: Do not load the artifact with this runtime; update llama.cpp to build b8146 or later.

advisories.title: GHSA-96jg-mvhq-q7q7: heap buffer overflow in GGUF tensor parsing
advisories.explanation: This llama.cpp build is exposed to a vulnerable GGUF loader path when it loads GGUF artifacts. Applicability records loader exposure; it does not claim that every GGUF file exploits the vulnerability. The primary advisory identifies builds below b7437 as affected and b7824 as patched; builds b7437 through b7823 are therefore left unchecked rather than inferred safe.
advisories.action: Do not load the artifact with this runtime; update llama.cpp to build b7824 or later.

advisories.title: SGLang template injection via /v1/rerank endpoint
advisories.explanation: SGLang renders tokenizer.chat_template via jinja2.Environment() instead of ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment on the /v1/rerank endpoint. The PoC public exploits SGLang 0.5.9; versions before 0.5.10 are affected. Earlier ranges in this bundle (< 0.4.0) were incorrect.
advisories.action: If using SGLang, update to version 0.5.10 or later. This advisory does not apply to llama.cpp.

advisories.title: Bleeding Llama: heap out-of-bounds read in Ollama GGUF loader
advisories.explanation: Ollama versions before 0.17.1 contain a heap out-of-bounds read in the GGUF loader (CVSS 9.1). Approximately 300,000 servers were affected. This advisory applies when Ollama is the detected runtime.
advisories.action: Update Ollama to version 0.17.1 or later. This advisory does not apply to llama.cpp directly.

advisories.title: Multiple vulnerabilities in GGUF parser (oss-security 2026-05-15)
advisories.explanation: Six weaknesses were reported in gguf.cpp and gguf_reader.py in May 2026, including integer overflows and out-of-bounds reads. The oss-security advisory lists remediations by severity but does not assign specific build numbers. The fixed build b8100 is inferred from the remediation timeline, not directly stated in the advisory.
advisories.action: Update llama.cpp to build b8100 or later to address all reported GGUF parser issues. The exact fix build may vary by specific issue.

advisories.title: CVE-2026-43631: use-after-free in llama-server vocab pointer when --sleep-idle-seconds is enabled
advisories.explanation: Remote unauthenticated code execution via the vocab pointer in llama-server when --sleep-idle-seconds is enabled. Affects builds b7492 through b9060; reported in early August 2026. The fix build b9061 is the advisory's stated remediation; Cancerbero mirrors it pending an upstream patched tag. This advisory only applies when the runtime is the llama.cpp ``llama-server`` binary with --sleep-idle-seconds enabled; non-server binaries or builds with the feature disabled are not exposed.
advisories.action: Update llama.cpp to build b9061 or later, or run ``llama-server`` without ``--sleep-idle-seconds`` until the patched build is available.
